description: Archi stradali is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sit.comune.fe.it. Mapping of the streets of the Municipality of Ferrara present in the Municipal Register of real estate (ACI) Description fields:IDSTD: Unique arc identifier CODVIA: Unique identifier of ViaNOMEVIA: Official name of ViaDATAINIZ: date of creation. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Road arches" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Nomi geografici, Reti di trasporto. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WFS. The listing shows 2024-11-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://w3id.org/italia/controlled-vocabulary/licences/A21_CCBY40). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
